newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BAAN, ASML IN A'DAM LIMIT ORDER BOOK.
newsitem.headline: BAAN, ASML IN A'DAM LIMIT ORDER BOOK.

text.p: The Amsterdam Exchanges said on Tuesday that shares in software firm Baan Company and semiconductor equipment maker ASM Lithography will be included in its Limit Order Book from February 24.

The Limit Order Book is confined to Amsterdam's 25 most actively traded companies, which together make up the AEX index, plus other actively traded shares where at least three financial firms are willing to act as a market maker.
All Limit Order Book companies are also included in Amsterdam's ASSET trading system for wholesale or block deals between interprofessional market players.
The components of the Limit Order Book are reviewed every year.

All 34 companies whose shares are now included in this system met the requirements. With the inclusion of Baan and ASM Lithography, the number of Limit Order Book companies rises to 36, the Amsterdam Exchanges said in a statement.
